items.title: :door: Knocks Board
items.what: Every rep's doors, knocks, talk-tos and each Optix disposition, read off Optix Lead Details on Nico's ECO computer. Time columns are blank on purpose: Optix doesn't record what time a door was knocked.
items.when: All day, on the schedule Nico picks on the Lucy ECO sign-up, plus a final board at night.

items.title: :drop_of_blood: Live App Alerts
items.what: When a rep's :drop_of_blood: count goes up in #alphalete-gp-sales, Lucy cheers it in the channel (each :drop_of_blood: = 1 app, the same count the reps already post).
items.when: Live, as the tally moves (afternoon to midnight).
items.text: William closed it. Anyone can do the job, nobody does it like William :dollar:

items.title: :satellite_antenna: Verizon Sales Board
items.what: Apps by rep by day for the week, with this week vs last week on the same days. From Credico's Sales Verification email.
items.when: Daily, about 11:15am, in the day's *Verizon Metrics* thread in #alphalete-gp-sales (previous-day numbers, like every program).

items.title: 🆕 Rep Activations
items.what: The last 4 weeks per rep (two pictures: this + last week, then the two before): activated, pending, total, canceled/disconnected.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: ⏳ Pending Orders
items.what: Every line that's submitted but not activated yet, grouped by rep, with how many days it's been waiting.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: 📈 Activation Rate by Rep
items.what: Per rep: % of lines activated, sold 0-30 days ago and 31-60 days ago. Green / yellow / red by the same bars as Carlos's board.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: 📆 Activation Rate by Week-Ending
items.what: The last 4 sales weeks: of the lines sold each week, how many have activated since. Office total + every rep.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: 📉 Churn Rates by Rep
items.what: Of the lines that activated 0-30 and 31-60 days ago, how many have disconnected since. Office total (the office churn rate) + every rep. Green 5% or less, yellow up to 10%, red over 10%.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: 📋 Order Log
items.what: Excel file: every line (rep, dates, order #, plan, device, ported from, status), plus a tab per rep. Pay dates are two weeks behind (one week later than the other programs).
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: 🚫 Canceled Orders
items.what: Lines Credico canceled in the last 3 days.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: ❎ Disconnected Orders
items.what: Lines that disconnected in the last 3 days.
items.when: Daily, same *Verizon Metrics* thread, right after the sales board.

items.title: :shield: Compliance Board
items.what: Credico's weekly compliance flags per rep: a ✓ for each thing Credico flagged.

items.title: :bar_chart: OPT Report Tab ("Nicolas Murrugarra – Verizon")
items.what: Nico's weekly rows on the OPT report, with the SAME row names as the NDS tabs so DD reads them the same way. Blank = Credico doesn't send that number yet.

items.title: :lock: Optix Signed-Out DM
items.what: If Optix signs out on Nico's ECO computer (Verizon does this about once a day), Lucy sends this so the knocks board doesn't just go quiet.
items.when: A DM to Nico, Megan and Eve, once a day at most, only when it happens.
items.text:
:lock: *Nicolas's Local Office — Lucy cannot sign into Verizon Optix.*
Your knocks board and sales alerts stopped updating at 4:10 PM. Nothing is lost — the numbers are still there, we just cannot see them.

*This has to be done on the office computer running LucyECO* — the same one you set up. Optix signed out on that computer — Verizon ends the sign-in about once a day.

At that computer, in Chrome: open Optix and sign in (last name + User ID, then password and the code). Pick the Consumer profile → Dashboard → SMART LEADS → Lead Details, and leave that tab open. Lucy picks it up within 10 minutes.
